chunks: Abū ʿAbdillāh Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated from Wahb ibn Wahb, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
None consume from lost property except those who are themselves astray.

key_terms.الضَّالَّةِ: lost property or a stray item that has gone missing from its owner
key_terms.الضَّالُّونَ: those who are astray or misguided
key_terms.قَالَ: he said, introducing the transmitted statement

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام say about consuming from lost property?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns taking benefit from lost property unlawfully. It presents such conduct as both a legal and moral deviation, linking misuse of another's property with being astray.
